attempts.summary: Configured tc/HTB traffic shaping on node1 (OpenWrt router) to cap node2's throughput through node1 to ~1 Mbit/s in both directions (egress HTB class filtered on dst 10.100.58.11, ingress redirected via ifb0 and HTB-shaped filtered on src 10.100.58.11), while leaving node1's own traffic and node1↔node3 traffic unshaped. Persisted the shaping via /etc/tc-node2-limit.sh invoked from /etc/rc.local. Demonstrated the limit with iperf3 transfers in both directions (node2→node1 ~874-917 Kbit/s, node1→node2 ~1.11-1.14 Mbit/s) and confirmed node3↔node1 remained at ~70-75 Gbit/s unshaped. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes one at a time: captured baseline boot IDs, issued detached (setsid) reboot commands whose acknowledgement returned before disconnection, polled until exec was available again, and proved changed boot IDs (node1 eb80a43a→a379200b, node2 225ffbf7→19b37836, node3 0d49f077→616c3e9c) plus post-restart recovery — tc shaping/config persisted and re-verified working on node1, and node2/node3 network + iperf3 connectivity recovered and re-tested.
